# Walgreens
> Pharmacy, health, wellness, and photo retail platform for prescriptions, immunizations, shopping, rewards, and online order management.

Walgreens combines online pharmacy services, everyday health and wellness shopping, photo printing, and account-based order management. Customers can refill prescriptions, manage vaccination records, shop products for pickup or delivery, earn Walgreens Cash rewards, and access drug and health resources.

## Pharmacy & Prescriptions
- [Prescription Refills & Status](https://www.walgreens.com/rx-refillhub/refillhub-holistic): Refill prescriptions online and check prescription order and processing status.
- [Pharmacy](https://www.walgreens.com/pharmacy/pharmacy.jsp): Main pharmacy hub for prescriptions, refills, transfers, and pharmacy services.
- [Transfer Prescription](https://www.walgreens.com/pharmacy/transferRx): Move prescriptions to Walgreens from another pharmacy provider.
- [Prescription Savings Club](https://www.walgreens.com/topic/pharmacy/prescription-savings-club.jsp): Information about savings options for eligible prescription medications.
- [Drug Information Search](https://www.walgreens.com/rx-druginfo/pharmacy/finddrug/druginfosearch): Search drug information for prescription and over-the-counter medications.
- [Find Care](https://www.walgreens.com/findcare): Access healthcare services, treatment options, and care-related resources.

## Immunizations & Health Services
- [Vaccines](https://www.walgreens.com/topic/pharmacy/immunization-services.jsp): Overview of immunization services, vaccine availability, and scheduling information.
- [Vaccination Records](https://www.walgreens.com/immunizationservice/pharmacy/immunization/ViewImmunizeHistory.jsp): View and manage immunization history and vaccination records.
- [COVID-19 Testing](https://www.walgreens.com/findcare/covid19/testing): Find COVID-19 testing options and appointment information.
- [COVID-19 Vaccines](https://www.walgreens.com/findcare/vaccination/covid-19): Learn about COVID-19 vaccine availability and scheduling.
- [Flu Shots](https://www.walgreens.com/findcare/vaccination/flu): Information on flu vaccination services and appointments.
- [Healthcare Clinic Services](https://www.walgreens.com/findcare/clinic): Explore clinic-based care and treatment service options.

## Account, Orders & Reordering
- [Your Account](https://www.walgreens.com/youraccount/default.jsp): Manage personal account settings, preferences, and saved information.
- [Order Status & History](https://www.walgreens.com/orderhistory/orders-ui): Track current orders and review previous purchases.
- [Buy It Again](https://www.walgreens.com/youraccount/dlorder/reorder.jsp): Reorder previously purchased items from account history.
- [Guest Order Lookup](https://www.walgreens.com/orderhistory/orders-ui/guestLookup): Look up order status without signing into an account.
- [Shopping Cart](https://www.walgreens.com/cart/cart.jsp): Review cart contents before checkout, pickup, or delivery.
- [Store Locator](https://www.walgreens.com/storelocator/find.jsp): Find nearby Walgreens stores, pharmacy hours, and services.

## Rewards & Membership
- [myWalgreens Dashboard](https://www.walgreens.com/mywalgreens/dashboard.jsp): Manage myWalgreens membership, rewards activity, and Walgreens Cash balances.
- [myWalgreens](https://www.walgreens.com/topic/mywalgreens/mywalgreens.jsp): Overview of the myWalgreens loyalty program and member benefits.
- [Walgreens Cash Rewards](https://www.walgreens.com/mywalgreens/dashboard.jsp): Access Walgreens Cash rewards details and account activity.
- [Weekly Ad](https://www.walgreens.com/offers/offers.jsp): Browse current promotions, deals, and featured weekly savings.
- [Coupons](https://www.walgreens.com/offers/offers.jsp): View available digital offers and savings opportunities.
- [Sale Items](https://www.walgreens.com/store/store/category/productlist.jsp?N=200001): Shop discounted and promotional products across categories.

## Health & Wellness Shopping
- [Health & Wellness](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/health-wellness/ID=360434-tier3): Shop vitamins, medicine, first aid, and wellness essentials.
- [Medicine Cabinet](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/medicine-cabinet/ID=360425-tier3): Browse pain relief, cold and flu, digestive, and other medicine products.
- [Vitamins & Supplements](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/vitamins-supplements/ID=360437-tier3): Shop vitamins, minerals, and nutritional supplements.
- [Personal Care](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/personal-care/ID=360438-tier3): Explore oral care, deodorant, hygiene, and grooming products.
- [Sexual Wellness](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/sexual-wellness/ID=360553-tier3): Shop condoms, lubricants, pregnancy tests, and related wellness products.
- [Home Health Care Solutions](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/home-health-care-solutions/ID=361830-tier3): Find mobility, monitoring, and home medical support products.

## Beauty & Personal Care
- [Beauty](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/beauty/ID=360359-tier3): Shop makeup, skincare, hair care, and beauty tools.
- [Skin Care](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/skin-care/ID=360360-tier3): Browse cleansers, moisturizers, treatments, and sun care products.
- [Hair Care](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/hair-care/ID=360361-tier3): Shop shampoo, conditioner, styling, and hair treatment products.
- [Cosmetics](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/cosmetics/ID=360358-tier3): Explore makeup products for face, eyes, lips, and nails.
- [Fragrance](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/fragrance/ID=360362-tier3): Shop perfumes, colognes, and body sprays.
- [Men's Grooming](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/mens-grooming/ID=360363-tier3): Find shaving, beard care, and grooming essentials.

## Photo Services
- [Photo](https://photo.walgreens.com/store/home): Main photo hub for prints, cards, gifts, and custom products.
- [Prints](https://photo.walgreens.com/store/prints-and-enlargements): Order photo prints and enlargements online.
- [Same Day Pickup Photo](https://photo.walgreens.com/store/same-day-pickup): Create photo products available for same-day pickup.
- [Photo Cards](https://photo.walgreens.com/store/cards): Design personalized cards for holidays, events, and announcements.
- [Photo Gifts](https://photo.walgreens.com/store/photo-gifts): Create custom mugs, canvases, books, and gift items.
- [Passport Photos](https://photo.walgreens.com/store/passport-photos): Learn about passport photo services and availability.

## Everyday Shopping
- [Shop All Products](https://www.walgreens.com/store/store/category/productlist.jsp): Browse Walgreens product categories and general merchandise.
- [Grocery & Household](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/grocery-household/ID=360399-tier3): Shop pantry, cleaning, paper, and household essentials.
- [Baby, Kids & Toys](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/baby-kids-toys/ID=360401-tier3): Browse baby care, kids products, and toys.
- [Pet Supplies](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/pet-supplies/ID=360400-tier3): Shop food, treats, and care products for pets.
- [Contact Lenses](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/contact-lenses/ID=350006-tier3contactlens): Order contact lenses from major vision brands.
- [Electronics](https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/electronics/ID=360402-tier3): Browse small electronics, accessories, and convenience items.

## Customer Help & Policies
- [Help Center](https://www.walgreens.com/help/help.jsp): Access customer support topics and self-service help resources.
- [Contact Us](https://www.walgreens.com/topic/help/generalhelp/contactus_main.jsp): Find customer service contact options and support information.
- [Shipping Information](https://www.walgreens.com/topic/help/shophelp/shippinghelp_main.jsp): Review shipping methods, timing, and delivery details.
- [Returns Policy](https://www.walgreens.com/topic/help/shophelp/returns_help_main.jsp): Learn about returns, refunds, and exchange policies.
- [Pickup Information](https://www.walgreens.com/topic/help/shophelp/pickup_help_main.jsp): Understand store pickup processes and requirements.
- [Accessibility](https://www.walgreens.com/topic/help/generalhelp/accessibility_statement.jsp): Read Walgreens accessibility statement and support information.
